Protocol source: https://github.com/FOSWLY/vot.js/tree/9f7220c4af4df92f0df39805a1a47cc52d0323f2
Version 3.2.1, MIT (see licenses/vot.js-MIT.txt).

Unmodified generated protobuf, schema and public browser protocol configuration.
The small client in ../client.js follows secure.ts and providers/yandex.ts from that revision,
using Node's crypto and our existing HTTPS compatibility transport for Node 12.
No user credentials or third-party worker are used. This is an unofficial Yandex endpoint.
